convert_fine_tune_checkpoint: convert a fine-tuned PyTorch checkpoint to a release-ready checkpoint by merging backbone and heads config from the starting checkpoint
run_convert_checkpoint_cli: run the CLI tool to convert a fine-tune checkpoint to a release checkpoint using --fine-tune-checkpoint and --output-release-checkpoint args
convert_checkpoint_and_yaml: convert a fine-tune checkpoint and its YAML config to release format by removing finetune_config and copying backbone and heads
review_convert_fine_tune_checkpoint: review the convert_fine_tune_checkpoint function to understand how it merges starting checkpoint config into the fine-tuned checkpoint
refactor_convert_fine_tune_checkpoint: refactor the convert_fine_tune_checkpoint function to support additional checkpoint format transformations
